title: runs.send result

runId.description: The run the message started, or the run live when it was queued.

messageId.description: A user message's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when a client sends it, and the id the provider is handed.

delivery.description: prompt: no run was live, so the message started one; queued: a run was live, so the message waits to be steered or read.

anyOf.description: Who holds a queued message: the provider's queue (it may steer it into the running turn), or the environment's (the next run starts with it).

heldBy.description: Who holds a queued message: the provider or the environment; null for a prompt.

description: What runs.send answers: the message started a run, or it was queued during the live run, and who holds it.
